lines.text: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld the request of his lips.
The LORD welcomes the king with rich blessings and places a crown of pure silver on his head.
The king asked for life, and the LORD gave him length of days, and he trusts in the LORD and will not be shaken.
The LORD's hand will seize His enemies and place them in a fiery furnace, and the fire will consume them.
The enemies' schemes will not prevail, since the LORD will put them to shame, and the people will sing His praise.
